intuition: Reverse each link as the list is traversed, keeping the reversed prefix and the untouched suffix separate.

brute_force.approach: Copy node values, reverse the values, and write them back into the nodes.

optimal.approach: Iteratively save the next node, point the current node backward, then advance the previous and current pointers. A recursive version uses O(n) call-stack space.

edge_cases: A one-node list already has the required direction.
Save the original next pointer before reversing the current link.
